# omx width

Widens or narrows the stereo image, with an optional pseudo-stereo spread for a mono source and a bass-mono cutoff that keeps the lows centred.

- CLAP id: `org.openmixer.width`
- LV2 URI: `urn:openmixer:width`
- Parameters: 5, plus the host's bypass

## Panel

![The panel of omx width, drawn from its declaration](../images/panels/omx-width.png)

The panel as a host draws it from the declaration alone, every control at its default (`make panel-images`: omx-panel lays it out and its renderer draws it). Its sections and their controls, in order:

| Section | Controls |
|---|---|
| Width | Width, Pseudo, Pseudo Delay, Bass Mono, Bass Mono Frequency |

## Audio ports

| Direction | Name | Role | Channels |
|---|---|---|---|
| in | in | main | 2 (stereo) |
| out | out | main | 2 (stereo) |

## Pages

A page is where a host shows a parameter. In LV2 each page is a port group, `pg:group <urn:openmixer:width#<symbol>>`, whose `lv2:displayPriority` is the number below (a host that shows the higher first, as Zynthian does, shows the pages in port order). In CLAP each page is the module of its parameters (`clap_param_info.module`), the page labels joined by `/`.

| Page | LV2 group symbol | Priority | CLAP module | Parameters |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Width | `width` | 1 | `Width` | 5 |

## Parameters

Ids are the order below, 0 to 4; a parameter appended later takes the next id. The bypass's id is its own (below).

| Id | Symbol | Name | Unit | Min | Max | Default | Step or values | Flags | Page (priority) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | `widthPct` | Width | % | 0 | 200 | 100 | whole steps | automatable | Width (1) |
| 1 | `pseudo` | Pseudo |  | 0 | 2 | Off (0) | 0 Off, 1 Comb, 2 Haas | automatable | Width (1) |
| 2 | `pseudoMs` | Pseudo Delay | ms | 0 | 30 | 12 | continuous, linear | automatable | Width (1) |
| 3 | `bassMono` | Bass Mono |  | off | on | off | toggle | automatable | Width (1) |
| 4 | `bassMonoHz` | Bass Mono Frequency | Hz | 20 | 300 | 120 | whole steps | automatable | Width (1) |

## Bypass

CLAP: the host's bypass, a parameter named Bypass at id 2147418112 (0x7FFF0000) in every plugin, flagged automatable, stepped and bypass; 0 is processing, 1 bypassed. The id never moves when a parameter is appended.
LV2: the port `enabled` (`lv2:designation lv2:enabled`) at index 0, 1 is processing, 0 is bypassed; the output port `latency` at index 1 reports the latency in frames. Both come before the audio and parameter ports in every plugin, so neither moves; a preset or a session names a port by its symbol.
